title: Mint Lemonade
description: Whole lemons blitzed with mint and ice — peel included, which is where the perfume is. Strained once so it stays sharp rather than bitter.
notes: Use unwaxed lemons. If you can only get waxed ones, peel them and add a strip of zest back instead.

steps.text: Remove every seed from the quartered lemons.
steps.tip: One missed seed makes the whole jug bitter. This is the only fiddly part.

steps.text: Blitz the lemons with the sugar, salt, mint, ice, and half the cold water in short bursts.
steps.tip: Short bursts only. Long blending pulls bitterness out of the pith.

steps.text: Strain through a coarse sieve, pressing lightly, and top up with the remaining cold water.
Taste and adjust with more sugar or lemon, then serve over ice.
